risks.risk: Torch may not work (dead battery/failed LED) or may be weak/defective.
risks.proof: A short video showing the torch turned ON at full brightness, plus a close-up of any indicator lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not working/untested until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Battery capacity/health may be poor (short runtime) even if it turns on.
risks.proof: Video showing runtime test (e.g., continuous ON for a set duration) or a charging-to-ON cycle with time stamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as low-runtime/unknown battery condition.

risks.risk: Charging method/accessories may be missing or incompatible (charger/cable not included).
risks.proof: Photo of the charging port and all included items laid out (charger, cable, adapter) with clear labels.

risks.risk: Model/brand may not match the seller’s stated “DP Compact” (photos don’t clearly show model).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any label/engraving with model number/brand on the torch body and packaging (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic rechargeable LED torch (worst-case identity uncertainty).

proof_requests: Video of the torch switched ON (full brightness) and showing any indicator/charging light.
Close-up photo of the label/engraving showing brand and exact model number (if present).
Photo of the charging port plus all included accessories (charger/cable/adapter) laid out.
Photo of the receipt and warranty document (or a screenshot) showing date and model.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a rechargeable LED torch, but they don’t show the exact model/brand, charging accessories, or any working test. Without proof it works and matches the stated model, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
